welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.subtitle: The app that helps you look at your phones less, and at each other more.

errors.title: A small hiccup
errors.generic: Something didn't work. Nothing serious: you can try again.
errors.network: No connection right now. Your data will be back as soon as the network is.
errors.server: The service is taking a short break. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.throttled: Easy there: try again in a minute.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: A few seconds, and you can start together.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works great.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email: if an account exists, you will get a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentMessage: If an account matches this address, a link is on its way. Remember to check your spam folder.

errors.emailInvalid: This email does not look valid.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email. You can sign in.
errors.passwordWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Try a short sentence.

errors.generic: Sign-in did not go through. You can try again.
errors.email_in_use: An account already exists with this email. Sign in with your password.
errors.email_required: We need your email to create the account.
errors.provider_disabled: This sign-in method is not available yet.
errors.invalid_token: Sign-in could not be verified. Try again.
errors.invalid_nonce: Sign-in could not be verified. Try again.

setup.title: Your space for two
setup.message: Create your space, then invite the other with a code. Or join the space they already created.

pending.title: Your invitation code
pending.explain: Give this code to the other person, or send them the link. They just need to enter it in the app.
pending.shareMessage: Join me on {{brand}}. Our code: {{code}} — or open this link: {{link}}
pending.waiting: As soon as they join, your space will open.

active.title: You are together
active.message: Your space for two is ready. Take your time, there is nothing to fill in right now.

join.title: Join the other
join.invalidFormat: The code has 6 characters (letters and digits).

errors.invalid_code: This code does not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.expired_code: This code has expired. Ask the other person to generate a new one.
errors.own_couple: This is your own code: share it with the other person.
errors.already_in_couple: You are already part of a space for two.
